page.stateApiLead: GET · PUT · DELETE /state/:key plus POST /state/clear. Keys are namespaced: tenant:default:namespace:key. TTL in milliseconds, default 5 minutes.
page.stateHeroDescription: Plugins are stateless by default — every call starts fresh. State Broker stores state with TTL: in-memory, daemon, or Redis. The API never changes.
page.stateMetaDesc: State between plugin calls. In-memory, daemon, or Redis — one API.
page.stateCtaDescription: kb-dev start brings up the State Daemon automatically. Switch the backend in config — don't touch your services.

stateModes.title: In-Memory
stateModes.detail: Fast in-process cache. No infrastructure required. Data resets on restart.

stateModes.title: Redis
stateModes.detail: Shared state across instances with persistence. Same API — swap with a config change.

stateModes.title: Custom adapter
stateModes.detail: Implement ICache and bind in kb.config.json. Any backend you choose.
